"'''Deathfire'''" was a [[TIE pilot/Legends|TIE pilot]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Deathfire often piloted a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], and was specifically a member and veteran of [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadron]]. As the handle implied, Deathfire often dropped a salvo of proton bombs on the enemy.
